summary: Added January and July 2022 regional scenarios for the Pacific and Atlantic North Equatorial Countercurrents and the South Indian Current. All 32 original sections are retained: 30 locations support primary depth projection, with 2 gaps between adjacent sections. The earlier 64 scenarios and all canonical ownership lists are preserved. These are qualified model threshold estimates; they do not establish whole-current physical thickness, annual ranges, or volumes. Historical seasonal descriptions were not imposed on the model snapshots. All numerical work and tests ran sequentially in the cloud. The bounded read-retry mechanism was tested; no retries were needed for this collection.
